# Swimming (skill)

Description: Determines stamina drain while swimming.

# Introduction

Swimming is a skill.

## Effects

Raising the swim skill decreases the amount of stamina that is used down to -50%.

## Leveling up

Swimming in any body of water grant 0.3 Experience per second, even if the player is out of stamina and drowning. Wading and treading water does not grant experience.
